# Printing the case

The enclosure is a custom design, free on MakerWorld.

👉 **[makerworld.com/@FormFollowsF](https://makerworld.com/de/models/2713675-spoolmanscale#profileId-3005075)**

---

## Printing

| | |
|---|---|
| Plates | All parts fit on 3 plates, currently spread across 4 |
| Time | roughly 4 to 6 hours |
| Material | PLA or PETG for the body |
| Feet | TPU grips better; self-adhesive silicone feet work just as well |

---

## Fit

!!! note "Display fit"
    The WT32-SC01 Plus sits in a recess sized to the board. If yours is a hair
    tight, check for elephant's foot on the first layer before reaching for a
    knife.

Screws and quantities are on the [bill of materials](bom.md#additional-materials).

---
